size_rationale: Small because the one-line fix is in one file and the quoted error 'must be a valid mongo id' is emitted on the line right after the faulty regex, so the prompt points straight at the place.
prompt: GET /v1/users/:id returns 400 'userId must be a valid mongo id' for ids that are valid 24-character Mongo ObjectIds.

root_cause.detail: The objectId validator's regex requires exactly 12 hex characters ({12}) instead of 24, so every real ObjectId fails Joi validation with 400 on GET/PATCH/DELETE /v1/users/:userId.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users/:userId > should return 200 and the user object if data is ok
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > DELETE /v1/users/:userId > should return 204 if data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 200 and the user object if data is ok|should return 204 if data is ok'
